description: Stations Sismiques et Accélérométriques de l’ORB is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Observatoire royal de Belgique. The Belgian seismic network of the Royal Observatory of Belgium (ROB), with about 45 permanent stations, is mainly dedicated to the monitoring and the scientific study of the seismic activity in Belgium. The ROB is also managing 3 stations in the Grand-Duchy of Luxemburg (in cooperation with the European Center for Geodynamics and Seismology). Coverage: Observatoire royal de Belgique. The portal shows the English title as "ROB Seismic and Accelerometric Stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Observatoire royal de Belgique. Its keywords include Gouvernement fédéral, Earthquakes, Tremblements de terre, Federale regering, Föderale Regierung, België. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
